method: For each control and preset, a step is marked broken when the output clips (more than 0.1% of samples at full scale), falls toward silence (more than a quarter of it below −55 dBFS, or 24 dB under the control's default), is overdriven (louder than −12 dBFS RMS: the model's output at the defaults sits between −28 and −41), or turns to noise (spectral flatness above 0.3 and three times the default's). The control's safe range is the run of unbroken steps around its default that every preset shares. Within it, the knob is laid out by timbre: equal travel gives equal change in the level-free spectrum (measure.timbre_distance between neighbouring steps, averaged over presets), so the knob spends its travel where the sound changes and passes quickly where it does not. A changed sampler takes a different path, so every step also differs by what seeds alone do (the noise floor: the defaults on other seeds); that is subtracted first. 40% of the travel is spread evenly over the steps, so every setting stays in reach, and a control whose changes stay within the floor is laid out in even steps. A dose knob is laid out on each side of 0 separately, so 0 stays at the centre.
